detail.longDescription:
Runable is the highest-ranked AI general agent in the world, independently verified across four industry standard benchmarks. Describe any task in plain language. Runable researches, plans, builds, and delivers the finished results end to end.

One app. One prompt. Done.

PROVEN PERFORMANCE — INDEPENDENTLY BENCHMARKED
Runable holds state-of-the-art scores on benchmarks that evaluate real-world AI agent capability:
GAIA (General AI Assistants): 92.1% — ahead of Genspark (87.8%) and Manus (86.5%)
DRACO (Deep Research): 68.3% — surpassing Perplexity Deep Research (67.15%)
BrowseComp (OpenAI web navigation): 76%
SlidesBench (presentation generation): State-of-the-art 

WHAT YOU CAN BUILD

Websites
Full-stack websites with database, payments, authentication, custom domains, and analytics — deployed live in minutes. No coding required.

Presentations
Professional slide decks from a single prompt. Choose from dozens of premium templates or let the AI design from scratch. Export as PPTX or PDF.

Videos
Generate and edit videos from text or images. Motion control, multi-shot timelines, and AI-generated audio. Built for social content, explainers, and product demos.

Reports
Research-grade documents with real citations, data analysis, charts, and polished formatting. Ready to share or present.

Audio and Podcasts
Text-to-speech, music generation, voice cloning, dubbing, and transcription. Full podcast production in one place.

Carousels
Swipeable multi-slide posts for Instagram, LinkedIn, and X. Designed and exported in seconds.

Spreadsheets
Generate or edit Excel and CSV files with formulas, charts, and formatting.

Images
Text-to-image generation, background removal, upscaling, and region-based editing.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Describe what you need in plain language.
2. Runable asks clarifying questions to understand your goal.
3. The AI agent plans, builds, and delivers your result.
4. Review, refine, and export — all within one app.
No switching between tools. No learning curves.

KEY CAPABILITIES
Plan Mode: The agent researches and plans before building. You review every step before execution begins.
Memory: Runable remembers your preferences, brand colors, and style across sessions.
Agent Skills: Installable workflows that extend the agent with new capabilities and templates.
3,000+ App Integrations: Connect with Slack, Discord, Telegram, Google Workspace, and thousands of other services.
Version History: Roll back to any previous version or branch a conversation to explore alternatives.
Export Anything: Download as PDF, PPTX, MP4, PNG, XLSX, CSV, or deploy live with a custom domain.

WHO USES RUNABLE
Founders and entrepreneurs shipping websites, pitch decks, and marketing content fast.
Marketing and content teams generating on-brand assets without developer support.
Students and educators building presentations, reports, and study materials.
Businesses creating internal tools, documentation, and reports at scale.
Developers prototyping full-stack applications and automating workflows.

REPLACE YOUR ENTIRE TOOL STACK
Most professionals pay for five or more separate AI subscriptions — ChatGPT, Canva, Gamma, Lovable, Perplexity, MidJourney, Runway, and others. Runable replaces them all. Users save an average of $129/month by consolidating into a single platform.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY
All tasks run inside a secure, sandboxed environment. Your data stays private. Runable does not train on your content.

Trusted by over 500,000 users worldwide.
